editorial:
Imagine being so desperate to escape your life that you would risk everything just for a chance at a new start. You will meet Tavo and Marina, a young couple in Bogota who spend their days stealing wallets at the airport just to feed their families. They are tired of the struggle and dream of moving to New York. When a drug dealer named Oskar offers them a way out by smuggling drugs inside their own bodies, they take the deal. It is a scary gamble, especially since Marina already lost her sister to the same dangerous job. The mood is tense from the start, making you feel the pressure these two are under.

What really works here is how the movie shows the panic that sets in once they actually land in the US. The acting feels real, and you can see the fear in their eyes as their dream starts to fall apart. While the pace slows down a bit in the middle, the stress of the airport scenes keeps you on edge. If you enjoy gritty crime stories about people pushed to the limit, you should definitely check this out.
endingExplained: Everything goes wrong when the couple arrives in New York. Their nerves get the best of them, and the authorities pick up on their panic. Instead of finding a new life, they end up trapped in a nightmare. The drug packets inside them become a ticking time bomb. By the end, the hope they had is completely gone, showing that the risk they took was too high and the dream of the city was a lie.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves realistic crime stories and dramas about desperate people.
